annotations.text:
agentswitchboard.org — drafted against site/PRINCIPLES.md.

Hero leads with the collision, not the category (p1).
The expiry gets its own section (p2).
The terminal block is real output from demo/run.sh (p3, p4).
Four primitives, no padding to six (p5).
Two flavors as equals, with what doesn't ship stated at the offer (p6, p7).
Three hosts explained, not just obeyed (p9).

The mobile artboard is a responsive CHECK, not a reduced page.

It carries the hero, the recording, the expiry, the primitives and the two flavors — enough to see what breaks at 390px.

The shipped page has every section at every width: the listener, the three-hosts argument and the viewer/island cards are NOT desktop-only. Don't read their absence here as a cut.

Still open:

• The terminal is drawn as static text here. On the real page it plays site/demo.cast.
• Nav, footer and the two 'verify it yourself' links are placeholders.
• pyproject says 2.3.0, the README says pre-1.0. The page currently prints BOTH — v2.3.0 in the header and 'Early release' in the hero. One of the two has to give before ship.
